# wikiHow

> > wikiHow is the world's most comprehensive how-to guide platform, offering expert-verified tutorials on everything from technology and relationships to spirituality and culture.

wikiHow provides step-by-step instructions and guides across countless topics, written and reviewed by experts. The platform covers practical tech tutorials (iPhone, iPad, Windows, Mac, iCloud, Facebook Dating), relationship advice, cultural knowledge (slang, vintage vocabulary), spiritual guidance (angel numbers, numerology), LGBTQIA+ education, and much more, making it a trusted resource for learning any skill or understanding any topic.

## Key Topics

- Technology tutorials (iPhone, iPad, Windows, Mac, iCloud)
- Relationship advice and dating guidance
- Facebook Dating and social media features
- Angel numbers and numerology
- Spirituality and symbolic meanings
- LGBTQIA+ terminology and identity (Achillean)
- Historical slang and vintage vocabulary (1930s American slang)
- wikiHow Pro expert-verified content
- Tech Help Pro support services
- Pop culture references (Taylor Swift, 90s nostalgia)
- Card games and entertainment
- Tattoo symbolism and meanings
- Health and nutrition (calorie planning)
- Network administration and file sharing
